latestVersion.changelog:
AI Social Copy Generator — v1.0.0

- Initial release: Instantly generates platform-specific social media captions from uploaded videos.
- Supports video uploads (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM) up to 500MB; also accepts images and audio.
- Automatic cloud processing delivers captioned, ready-to-post MP4s in 20–40 seconds.
- Handles video edits, BGM, text overlays, and exports within a simple chat workflow.
- Built-in credit management, file validation, and error handling for a seamless user experience.
